1.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
1.comment: Inspectors observed glass cleaner to be stored above food items on a metal shelving unit. The food items included flour, chips, and candy. Ensure that cleaning supplies and other chemicals are stored separate from food items to avoid contamination.

2.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
2.comment: The PIC was unable to provide the inspectors with signed employee health reporting agreements. After looking through the handbook we were unable to verify that the employees have acknowledged the reporting agreements. Copies of the employee health reporting agreements and the lists of diagnosis and symptoms that require exclusion from food service were provided to the PIC.

3.title: Food separated and protected.
3.comment: Inspector observed an unsealed package of hot dogs to be stored in direct contact with a personal take-out bag of fast food. The PIC was informed that this storage method is hazardous due cross contamination. The hot dogs were sealed and moved to a safe position in the cooler during today’s visit. Ensure personal items are stored below food for the consumer or in a non-permeable container to prevent cross-contamination.

4.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
4.comment: Inspectors observed a container of jalapeños and a container of pickles to be stored on the counter. The packaging of both items state they must be refrigerated after opening. This was brought to the attention of the PIC and she stated they usually keep these items refrigerated. The PIC voluntarily discarded the jar of jalapeños and the jar of pickles. Ensure that all items that require refrigeration are kept at or below 41 degrees Fahrenheit.

5.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
5.comment: Inspectors observed personal items stored intermixed with items intended for consumers in the walk in cooler. To avoid contamination of products for the consumer inspectors suggested a bin or crate to be used to contain personal items to keep them separate from merchandise. Preferred storage of this bin is on the bottom shelf.
